page.overview:
Who is Zoe?

Zoe was born on Caladan. She left when she was branded a traitor by House Atreides and relocated to Arrakis, where she became a vendor. She became copilots with Valentin, a deserter of House Harkonnen. They stole an Atreides transport and bought their way into the smugglers, who retrofitted a crashed ship called Fallen Light into a base.

Zoe was approached by the Prisoner at the Crossroads. She told them of her history and of the crashed ships in Hagga Rift. She also told them of the Maas Kharet and their murderous actions.
